sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in a unified table; Institutional Red-Teaming ranked first after recent duplicate themes were excluded.
The main agent read the arXiv PDF and HTML, extracting IABench-CA design, IAG formula, rule coordinates, tables, ablations, and certification workflow.
The article decomposes consequence rules, context grid, cooperative-refinement reference, population heterogeneity, identity-salience ablation, and safety-case algorithm.
The article calls out the simplified 3-agent game, limited rule set, hosted model snapshots, normative reference dependence, pending artifact, and lack of real tool-chain evidence.
The analysis positions the paper against ordinary model red-teaming, tool-use safety, prompt injection, trace integrity, and mechanism-design perspectives without overclaiming third-party commentary.
The Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external images or direct image URLs were used.
